about.lead: I'm a back-end developer focused on Java and Spring Boot. I enjoy turning business rules into clear, well-tested APIs that are easy to evolve.
about.body: I got into programming out of curiosity about how things work behind the screen — and stayed for the satisfaction of building systems that solve real problems. Today I split my time between personal projects, continuous study and improving this portfolio, which I also built from scratch. I work with attention to detail: readable code, well-described commits, tests that protect refactors and interfaces that respect their users.
about.lookingFor: Back-end developer opportunities (Java/Spring), freelance projects with well-defined scope and teams that value clean code and good practices.
